__: Projection Phase 9 — the Usenet control-plane configuration, as a template.
COPY IT, EDIT THE PATHS, AND KEEP IT OUT OF THE REPOSITORY. Every value here is a PATH or an address.
There is no field in this document that holds a credential, an NZB URL or an indexer key, and there is
not meant to be: the API key is a file this names, and an NZB source is a file you name per submission.
A configuration that leaked would leak your host layout and nothing else.
EVERY PATH MUST BE ABSOLUTE AND POSIX. A relative one would resolve against whatever directory the
command happened to be run from, and `usenet-command-cli.ts preflight` refuses one rather than guessing.
THE COMPLETED ROOT MUST BE STRICTLY BELOW THE MEDIA ROOT. An admitted file is published as a `local`
source, and a local locator is a configured root id plus a relative path under it — so a completed
directory outside the media root cannot be named by one at all. Preflight says so before you submit.
THE STATE DIRECTORY MUST BE DURABLE, AND MUST NOT BE THE DAEMON'S CACHE DIRECTORY. The job ledger lives
in `usenet-ledger/` beneath it and is the only reason a restart does not submit your download a second
time. projectiond sweeps the top level of its cache directory at startup; a ledger there would be an
exactly-once guarantee that silently resets every time the appliance restarts.
Delete this `__` key or leave it; the parser refuses unknown keys, so it must be removed before use.
